# Architecture Checklist: AVD Emulator Setup

**Purpose**: Validate architectural requirements quality for emulator setup
**Created**: 2026-11-04
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and verified as meeting the requirements-quality standard.

## Architecture & Design Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 - Are the architecture boundaries (Rust playback authority vs Kotlin shell mirror) explicitly accounted for in emulator setup requirements? [Completeness, Spec §User Scenarios]
- [x] CHK002 - Is the target platform architecture (x86_64 host, Android API 29+, Tauri 2.12.1) clearly specified? [Clarity, Spec §Technical Context]
- [x] CHK003 - Are ABI selection requirements (x86_64 for emulator, aarch64 for gate 9) explicitly documented? [Clarity, Plan §Summary]
- [x] CHK004 - Is the relationship between host gates (1-8) and device/emulator requirements clearly defined? [Completeness, Spec §User Scenarios]

## Integration Requirements

- [x] CHK005 - Are AVD configuration requirements (API level, ABI, device profile) specified with acceptable values? [Clarity, Spec §Assumptions]
- [x] CHK006 - Are SDK/NDK/emulator dependencies and their roles documented? [Completeness, Plan §Technical Context]
- [x] CHK007 - Is the integration with existing scripts (`verify.sh`, gate checks) addressed? [Coverage, Plan §Summary]
- [x] CHK008 - Are Tauri Android build target requirements clearly specified? [Clarity, Research §Decisions]

## Constraints & Assumptions

- [x] CHK009 - Are hardware acceleration requirements (KVM) documented with fallback options? [Completeness, Clarifications]
- [ ] CHK010 - Are offline/pure-offline constraints (no INTERNET permission) accounted for? [Consistency, Constitution]
- [x] CHK011 - Are minSdk 29 requirements enforced in setup constraints? [Consistency, Spec §Assumptions]
- [x] CHK012 - Are assumptions about pre-configured AVD explicitly stated? [Clarity, Spec §Assumptions]

## Notes

- Items focus on architectural requirements quality, not implementation details.
